title: CHAPTER 1: UNDERSTANDING INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS
content: ✨👋 ሰላም የተወደዳችሁ እና ውድ የኢትዮፍሬሽ ቤተሰቦች! እንኳን ወደ ምዕራፍ 1 ክፍል 1 (Part 1) ትምህርታችን በደህና መጣችሁ! በዚህ ክፍል ስለ ብሔር፣ መንግሥት፣ ብሔረተኝነት፣ የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት አመጣጥ እና መሠረታዊ የፖለቲካ ፍልስፍናዎች በዝርዝር እንመለከታለን👇👇👇። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Introduction & Overview 🔹 Navigating the Daily Flow of World News - International relations (IR) appears in daily news as a continuous stream of disparate global events: diplomatic meetings, international negotiations, war outbreaks, and acts of terror. - 👉 በየቀኑ በዜና የምንሰማቸው የዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች ስብሰባ፣ የጦርነት ዜናዎች፣ የዲፕሎማሲ ድድርድሮች እና ሌሎች ክስተቶች በሙሉ የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት (International Relations) መገለጫዎች ናቸው። 🔹 Academic Approach: Simplifying the Messy Picture - Rather than focusing strictly on isolated daily news events, academic IR studies the foundational principles, historical roots, and underlying structures that connect these events. - 👉 በዩኒቨርሲቲ ደረጃ የዓለም አቀፍ ትምህርት ዋና ዓላማ ዕለታዊ ዜናዎችን ብቻ መከታተል ሳይሆን፣ ከእነዚህ ክስተቶች ጀርባ ያሉትን መሰረታዊ ህጎች፣ ቲዮሪዎችና ታሪካዊ መነሻዎች በጥልቀት መረዳት ነው። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🎯 Chapter Objectives - Define and distinguish the concepts of nation, state, nationalism, and nation-state. - Explain the historical evolution and academic development of International Relations. - Examine diverse perspectives, theoretical paradigms, and analytical approaches in IR. - Identify key actors in world politics using the three levels of analysis (Individual, State, Systemic). - Analyze the structure of the international system and the laws/norms governing it. 💡 Exam Hint: በፈተና ወቅት በ 'Nation', 'State' እና 'Nation-state' መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት እንዲሁም የ 3 Levels of Analysis ጥያቄዎች በብዛት ይጠየቃሉ። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.1. Conceptualizing Nationalism, Nations, and States 🔹 Nationalism as a Dominant Global Force - Nationalism is historically the most influential force in international affairs. It has triggered revolutions, caused world wars, collapsed ancient empires, drawn national borders, created new states, and legitimized regimes. - 👉 ብሔረተኝነት (Nationalism) በዓለም ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቁን ድርሻ የሚይዝ ኃይል ነው። የቆዩ ኢምፓየሮችን በመናድ፣ አዳዲስ ሀገራትን በመፍጠር እና ድንበሮችን በማስመር ረገድ ወሳኝ ሚና ተጫውቷል። 🔹 Heywood’s Definition of Nationalism - According to Andrew Heywood (2014), nationalism is the doctrine that asserts the nation as the basic political unit in organizing human society. - 👉 እንደ ሄይዉድ ገለጻ፣ ብሔረተኝነት ማለት 'ብሔር (Nation)' ማህበረሰብን ለማደራጀት መሰረታዊው የፖለቲካ አካል ነው ብሎ የሚያምን ርዕዮተ-ዓለም ነው። 🔹 Clarifying Everyday Terminology: Nation vs. State vs. Country - In common language, 'nation', 'state', and 'country' are incorrectly used interchangeably. - Example: The term 'United Nations' is technically a misnomer; in reality, it is an organization of states, not nations. - Likewise, calling the 'Chinese', 'Americans', or 'Russians' simply 'nations' is politically imprecise. - 👉 በዕለት ተዕለት ውይይት 'Nation'፣ 'State' እና 'Country' የሚሉትን ቃላት አደባልቀን እንጠቀማለን። ነገር ግን በፖለቲካ ሳይንስ ትርጉም አላቸው። ለምሳሌ 'United Nations' (የተባበሩት መንግሥታት) የእውነቱ ከሆነ የ 'States' ስብስብ እንጂ የ 'Nations' ስብስብ አይደለም። 🔹 What is a Nation? - According to Heywood (2014), nations are historical entities that evolve organically out of similar ethnic communities, manifesting through shared myths, legends, culture, and songs. - A nation constitutes a human community bound by a shared socio-cultural identity and common practices. - 👉 ብሔር (Nation) የሚባለው የጋራ ባህል፣ ታሪክ፣ ቋንቋ እና የማንነት ስሜት ያለው የሰዎች ስብስብ/ማህበረሰብ ነው። 🔹 The Emergence of the 'Nation-State' Compound - Toward the end of the 18th century, the political 'state' fused with the socio-cultural 'nation' to create the nation-state. - Early modern states provided institutional machinery (body), while the nation provided shared socio-political soul (interior life). - Nationalist leaders argued that the nation must control state institutions to advance collective national goals. - 👉 በ18ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን መገባደጃ ላይ 'State' (የፖለቲካው መዋቅር) እና 'Nation' (ህዝቡ/ማንነቱ) ተዋህደው 'Nation-State' የሚለውን አዲስ የፖለቲካ አካል ፈጠሩ። ህዝቡ ለመንግሥት መዋቅር እንደ 'ነፍስ' ሆኖ አገልግሏል። 🔹 Historical Catalysts: The American (1776) and French (1789) Revolutions - American Revolution (1776): Introduced 'We the People of the United States' in the Preamble to the US Constitution, asserting popular sovereignty. - French Revolution (1789): Overthrew the monarchy, aristocracy, and church dominance. It established governance based on the nation and the principles of Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité (Liberty, Equality, Brotherhood). - 👉 የ1776ቱ የአሜሪካ እና የ1789ኙ የፈረንሳይ አብዮቶች ህዝብ የፖለቲካ ስልጣን ባለቤት መሆኑን በማወጅ ለሌሎች ሀገራት ብሔረተኝነት መንገድ ከፈቱ። 🔹 The Congress of Vienna (1815) and Liberal Nationalism - Designed to return Europe to pre-revolutionary imperial order after the Napoleonic Wars. - However, 19th-century liberal nationalism promoted self-determination—the right of a distinct people to determine its own political fate. - National self-determination directly threatened multi-ethnic European empires by demanding boundary redraws. - 👉 የቪየና ኮንግረስ አሮጌውን የኢምፓየር ስርዓት ለመመለስ ቢሞክርም፣ የህዝቦች 'ራስን በራስ የማስተዳደር መብት' (Self-determination) ጥያቄ ኢምፓየሮችን ማፍረስ ጀመረ። 🔹 The Uprisings of 1848 to the Post-WWI Settlement - 1848 Nationalist Uprisings: Spread across Europe demanding popular self-rule. Though suppressed short-term, the middle class continued pushing nationalist demands (e.g., Finns, Bulgarians, Serbs). - 1861 Italian Unification: Transformed city-states dominated by the Church into a unified nation-state. - 1918 Post-WWI: Self-determination was formally recognized as an international right, leading to widespread creation of nation-states across Europe. - 👉 ከ1848 አብዮቶች እና ከ1861 የጣሊያን መዋሃድ በኋላ፣ በአንደኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ማብቂያ (1918) 'Self-determination' እንደ ዓለም አቀፍ መብት ተቀባይነት አግኝቶ በርካታ ሀገራት ተመሰረቱ። 🔹 Evolution from Inter-State to Inter-National System - The 1648 Peace of Westphalia established an inter-state system (relations between states). - The 19th-20th century transformed this into a truly inter-national system (relations between nation-states). - The word 'international' was first coined in 1783 by British philosopher Jeremy Bentham. - Modern nation-states maintain formal sovereign equality under international law. - 👉 የዌስትፋሊያ ስርዓት 'በመንግስታት መካከል (Inter-state)' የነበረ ሲሆን፣ በ19ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ወደ 'በብሔር-መንግስታት መካከል (Inter-national)' ተቀየረ። 'International' የሚለውን ቃል ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በ1783 የፈጠረው ጄረሚ ቤንታም ነው። 🔹 Contemporary Debates on Nationalism - Challenge: Globalization and transnational networks challenge traditional nation-state sovereignty. - Revival: Post-Cold War resurgence of ethnic, cultural, and religious identities (e.g., Samuel Huntington’s 'Clash of Civilizations' vs. Francis Fukuyama’s 'End of History'). - 👉 አሁን ባለንበት ዘመን የግሎባላይዜሽን እድገት የብሔር-መንግስታትን ስልጣን ቢፈታተነውም፣ ከቀዝቃዛው ጦርነት በኋላ የሃይማኖትና የብሔር ማንነቶች ማደግ (Huntington's Clash of Civilizations) የብሔረተኝነትን እንደገና ማንሰራራት ያሳያል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 1.2. Understanding International Relations 🔹 Everyday Impact of International Relations - International relations directly shapes individual daily life; isolation is impossible. - Cultural Interaction: An Ethiopian student watching foreign media (e.g., Friends) participates in international culture. - Travel & Environment: Flying from Addis Ababa to London involves international airspace laws and impacts global climate change. - Commerce: Purchasing fair-trade coffee or working for local/multinational firms involves international trade, employment, and tax laws. - 👉 የዓለም አቀፍ ግንኙነት በዕለት ተዕለት ሕይወታችን ውስጥ ቀጥታ ተጽዕኖ አለው። የውጭ ፊልሞች ማየት፣ በአየር መንገድ መጓዝ፣ ቡና መገበያየት እና በኩባንያዎች ውስጥ መስራት በሙሉ ከአለም አቀፍ ህጎችና ግንኙነቶች ጋር የተያያዙ ናቸው። 🔹 Why We Academic Study IR - Studying IR enables individuals to systematically interpret news and global issues beyond simple journalism. - As members of an interconnected world community, citizens must understand both rights and global responsibilities. - 👉 የ IR ትምህርት የዓለም አቀፍ ክስተቶችን መንስኤና ውጤት በጥልቀት እንድንተነትን እና እንደ ዓለም ዜጋ መብታችንንና ኃላፊነታችንን እንድናውቅ ይረዳናል። 🔹 Academic Origins of IR - Term 'international relations' used by Jeremy Bentham in 1798. - Originally taught under law, philosophy, or history. - Following World War I devastation, the first dedicated Chair of International Relations was established at the University of Wales in 1919 to study war prevention. - 👉 እንደ ትምህርት ዘርፍ የመጀመሪያው የ IR ክፍል የተከፈተው ከ1ኛው የዓለም ጦርነት በኋላ በ1919 እ.ኤ.አ በዌልስ ዩኒቨርሲቲ (University of Wales) ነበር። ዓላማውም የጦርነትን ስጋት መቀነስና ሰላምን ማስፈን ነበር። 🔹 Defining International Relations Today - Broadly describes interactions between individuals, groups, corporations, political parties, nations, states, and non-governmental/governmental organizations across sovereign borders. - Includes both private/public interactions (travel, international mail, Olympics) and high-politics events (interstate conflict, global warming summits, international crime). - 👉 IR በሀገራት፣ ድርጅቶች፣ ኩባንያዎች እና ግለሰቦች መካከል ከድንበር ተሻጋሪ የሚደረጉ ማናቸውንም የፖለቲካ፣ ኢኮኖሚ እና ማህበራዊ ግንኙነቶች ያካትታል። 🔹 Anarchy and the Inescapability of International Politics - No state or individual can live in total isolation or dictate terms to the entire world. - Every state is a minority in an anarchic international system—meaning there is no global central sovereign/government overarching individual states. - Power is decentralized, making bargaining, coercion, and power dynamics central to international interactions. - 👉 በዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ 'Anarchy' ማለት ስርዓተ- አልበኝነት ማለት ሳይሆን፣ ከሀገራት በላይ የሆነ አንድ ጠቅላይ የዓለም መንግሥት (Common Sovereign) አለመኖሩን ያመለክታል። 🔹 Comparing Domestic vs. International Politics - Domestic Politics: Monopolizes legitimate force (police/courts enforce law); strong central sense of shared loyalty and authority. - International Politics: Lacks central enforcement (realm of self-help); relies on competing legal systems; power is unequally distributed. - Conflict and disagreement over public issues lie at the very heart of international politics. - 👉 በሀገር ውስጥ ፖለቲካ ህግ አስፈፃሚ አካል (ፖሊስ/ፍርድ ቤት) አለ፤ በዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካ ግን ህግን የሚያስገድድ ማዕከላዊ አካል ስለሌለ ሀገራት በራሳቸው አቅም (Self-help) ይተማመናሉ። 🔹 Domestic Incidents Becoming International Issues - Health crises like SARS and Avian Flu demonstrate how domestic events rapidly escalate into international security and foreign policy agendas. - 👉 በሀገር ውስጥ የሚከሰቱ የበሽታ ወረርሽኞች (እንደ SARS ወይም Avian Flu) በፍጥነት የዓለም አቀፍ ፖለቲካና የውጭ ፖሊሲ አጀንዳ ይሆናሉ። 🔹 Philosophical Foundations: Hobbes vs. Locke - Thomas Hobbes (1651): Viewed the state of nature as 'continual fear, and danger of violent death; and the life of man, solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short.' Underpins Realist assumptions of anarchic, self-interested international relations. - John Locke: Offered an optimistic view where humans are equal, sociable, governed by natural laws, and capable of social cooperation prior to government. Underpins Liberal/Idealist perspectives. - 👉 ቶማስ ሆብስ (Hobbes): የሰውን ልጅ ተፈጥሮአዊ ባህሪ አስከፊና ግጭት ወዳድ ነው ይለናል (የRealism መነሻ)። በተቃራኒው ጆን ሎክ (Locke): የሰውን ልጅ አዎንታዊና ተባባሪ ነው ይለናል (የLiberalism መነሻ) የትኛው ልክ ይመስላችኋል?። በኋላ እንመለስበታለን። 🔹 Power, Order, and Interdependence - Managing Conflict: States balance power with power. Non-violent diplomatic mechanisms exist alongside the unilateral use of force (e.g., the 2003 US-led invasion of Iraq). - Expanding Scope: International organizations grew from zero in 1800 to hundreds today. UN membership grew from 51 states in 1945 to 192+ states in the 21st century. - Interdependence: Mutual reliance among states, markets, and institutions for resources, security, and economic progress. - 👉 ከ1800 ወዲህ የዓለም አቀፍ ድርጅቶች ቁጥር ከመጨመሩም በላይ፣ የፈረንሳይና አሜሪካ አብዮቶች፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት (UN) አባላት ከ51 ወደ 192+ ማደግ ሀገራት እርስ በርሳቸው ጥገኛ (Interdependent) መሆናቸውን ያሳያል። ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🙌 ለዛሬ አብረን የቆየንበት የትምህርት ክፍለ ጊዜ እዚህ ላይ አብቅቷል። በቀጣዩ ክፍል (Part 2) ትምህርታችን እስክንገናኝ ድረስ በደህና ቆዩ! 🎓✨
